_comment: BiblioCommons library systems (mapsee_ingest_bibliocommons.py). One entry per library; `slug` is the tenant name in both gateway.bibliocommons.com/v2/libraries/<slug>/events and <slug>.bibliocommons.com. No key and no account. `city` and `country` are read only by catalog_curate's coverage report - the adapter ignores them - and they are here because two of the first six systems are Canadian, which the report was counting as American. `category` is only the fallback for a programme whose type and audience say nothing - most rows classify themselves, and library programming is overwhelmingly learning and kids. Every row arrives with a surveyed branch coordinate, so nothing here is geocoded; see the adapter header. Counts below were read live on 2026-09-03 and are recorded so a later run can tell a quiet library from a broken one. The 38 systems added 2026-09-24 carry `measured_2026_09_24`: programmes the adapter itself KEPT inside a 90-day horizon (58,629 between them), not the gateway's total. Three more systems added 2026-09-25 carry `measured_2026_09_25` (3,686 kept, 3,683 unique). 90 rather than 180 because the newer batches land in one sync step with a 20-minute limit; a library programme is listed well inside 90 days of happening, so the window rolls forward and loses nothing but distance.
